description: Ubuntu 24.04 development desktop with Chrome, VS Code, Claude Desktop, and the host virtualization devices required by Claude Cowork.
notes: Requires /dev/kvm and /dev/vhost-vsock on the selected Kasm agent, the host vhost_vsock kernel module, and device GIDs matching the sgx/kvm groups in the image. This grants the workspace direct hardware virtualization access. Run cowork-kasm-diagnose inside the workspace before starting Cowork.
